transcript:
SOURCE: Fathom (via HubSpot internal notes) — https://fathom.video/share/5mJZpn9meQGMR3izsAHaLbQ7M4TK3Fxr

AI Meeting Summary ✨

Generated by Fathom // View Recording (56 mins - No highlights)

Meeting Purpose

Explore growth strategies for a law firm struggling with lead generation.

Key Takeaways

PPC campaign is failing: The $5k/mo PPC campaign with Convert It is unprofitable, generating only ~1 private client/mo and losing money.

Goal is to double private cases: The firm aims to grow from 2–3 to 5–6 private cases/mo, adding ~$22.5k/mo in revenue to cover Lindsey's salary and enable hiring an associate.

SMB Team offers a holistic solution: SMB Team's 4-pillar model (Lead Gen, Intake, Team, Profit) provides a strategic alternative to the current vendor's tactical, click-focused approach.

Next step is a custom proposal: Nick will present a tailored plan with tiered options to address both immediate lead generation and long-term scaling goals.

Topics

The Problem: Unprofitable PPC & Unsustainable Growth

Current State: The firm relies on court-appointed work, with private cases at an unsustainable 2–3/mo.

PPC Campaign Failure:

Vendor: Convert It.

Budget: $5k/mo ad spend + $800/mo management fee.

Performance: Budget is exhausted in 3–4 days, yielding low-quality leads and an unprofitable return.

Website & SEO:

Vendor: Convert It.

Status: The $400/mo fee is for basic hosting, not active SEO. The firm's own organic efforts (blogging) are the primary driver of new clients.

Conversion Rate:

Performance: Extremely low. July: 9 calls → 2-3 clients. August: ~15 calls → 1 client.

Benchmark: SMB Team clients typically convert 15–25% of total leads.

The Goal: Sustainable Growth & Scalability

Primary Objective: Increase private cases to 5–6/mo.

Financial Impact: Adds ~$22.5k/mo in revenue.

Strategic Impact: Covers Lindsey's salary and funds hiring an associate.

Long-Term Vision: Build a scalable business not reliant on Christopher.

Goal: Hire an associate within 24–36 months to delegate court appearances and create a more resilient firm.

The Solution: SMB Team's Holistic Growth Model

Core Philosophy: A strategic partnership focused on growth, not a tactical vendor focused on clicks.

SMB Team's 4-Pillar Growth Model:

Lead Generation: Build a predictable engine (e.g., LSA, AI ads).

Intake & Sales: Optimize lead-to-client conversion.

Team Building: Create a hiring and delegation plan.

Profit Planning: Ensure growth is profitable.

LSA (Local Services Ads) as a Potential Solution:

Benefit: Pay-per-qualified-lead model, unlike PPC's pay-per-click.

Success Factors ("3 R's"): Responsiveness, Radius, and Reviews.

Next Steps

Nick:

Create a custom growth proposal with tiered options (e.g., immediate lead gen vs. full strategic partnership).

Send a meeting recap and calendar invite for the next call.

Christopher & Lindsey:

Review the proposal on the next call.

Provide any additional goals or feedback before the call.

All:

Next Call: Tuesday, August 18th, at 10:00 AM PT.

Action Items

Draft customized growth plan (options) for Aug 18 review w/ Chris & Lindsey - WATCH (5 secs)
Send calendar invite for Aug 18 10:00 PT (2h) to Chris & Lindsey; hard stop 13:00 CT - WATCH (5 secs)
Email Fathom recap to Chris & Lindsey - WATCH (5 secs)
